g1-implement.title: Add ubuntu-latest CI job and prove it can go red: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: add exactly one ubuntu-latest job to .github/workflows/ci.yml, mirroring the existing windows-latest job's steps (checkout, setup-python 3.12, install pytest+coverage, run the same test suite / skip-guard / coverage-floor commands the Windows job runs) with no defaults.run.shell override needed (bash is ubuntu's default shell). Do not touch triggers, do not restructure the workflow, do not add a matrix, do not touch the windows-latest job. Then demonstrate decision:prove-it-can-go-red locally (never by pushing a broken commit -- pushing a deliberately-broken commit to the PR branch risks landing it in main's history on a non-squash merge, and this environment is itself linux so it can run the exact job commands directly): with the new job's commands run locally against a deliberately-broken, uncommitted, then-reverted test mutation, capture the pytest command failing on the SPECIFIC named assertion (never a bare non-zero exit, never a crash), then revert the mutation (git diff --quiet -- tests/ confirms clean) and re-run green. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT as evidence: spine_evidence action=attach, task_id=g1-implement, evidence_type=implementer-result, fields={status: <verbatim lowercase Return status>}.

constraints: File ownership: .github/workflows/ci.yml only -- no other tracked file may be left changed.
decision:add-one-job-only -- single ubuntu-latest job, no matrix, no trigger changes, no workflow restructuring.
decision:windows-stays-red -- do not fix, delete, or disable the windows-latest job.
decision:ci-changes-beyond-this-are-surfaced -- any other ci.yml change is a decision to float, not make.
decision:prove-it-can-go-red -- red-proof required; use the local same-OS command-parity method (this worktree is linux), never a pushed broken commit.
The red-proof mutation must never be committed -- git diff --quiet -- tests/ (never git status --porcelain, per repo's autocrlf false-negative) must confirm a clean revert before the gate closes.

g1-integrate.title: Add ubuntu-latest CI job and prove it can go red: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: verify the crew's side-effects against the world yourself (re-read the ci.yml diff, confirm git diff --quiet -- tests/, confirm the red-proof evidence reproduces as described), then advance -- the command postcondition (full local suite) is satisfied by advance re-running it, never by attest. BLOCK: return the implementer for rework or raise a blocker if unresolvable. Log any out-of-scope finds as triage candidates.

preconditions.satisfied_by: REVIEW_RESULT received at g1-review (e-g1-review-1), verdict APPROVE.

postconditions.statement: full local suite green after the change; tests/ tree carries no leftover red-proof diff

why_trail.why: Implementer added exactly one ubuntu-latest job (test-linux) mirroring the windows-latest job's steps, no trigger/matrix/windows-job changes. Independently verified: git diff --stat shows only .github/workflows/ci.yml changed (30 insertions), git diff --quiet -- tests/ confirms clean revert, and the reverted test file matches its original assertion. Red-proof captured a specific named AssertionError (not a bare non-zero exit), then reverted and re-ran green. Result artifact verified fresh via run_crew.py --verify-result.

Reviewer independently reproduced the diff, the red-proof, and the full local suite (3729 passed, 9 skipped -- matches launch order baseline), and verdict is APPROVE. Reviewer flagged a real, pre-existing, out-of-scope defect: scripts/verify_skip_guard.py's allow-tuple refuses 8 skips pinned to a stale HEAD (9d5aac6d vs current 135c34eb) -- confirmed myself by running verify_skip_guard.py against a fresh full-suite junit report (exit 1). This means the mirrored skip-guard step in the new job would go red on first real CI run for a reason unrelated to this diff. Not fixing it here (out of file ownership and decision:ci-changes-beyond-this-are-surfaced); recording as an elevated triage candidate and floating it in RESULT.md.
Reviewer verdict APPROVE integrated. Running the c1 command postcondition (tests/ clean + full local suite) now.
